grammar_title: 不定式1(作宾语/补语/状语/定语)
source: 上外版必修三 Unit 2 Grammar in Use:Infinitives 1 — used as objects, complements, adverbials and attributives。句子地道、围绕艺术与艺术家主题、零术语、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: 不定式作宾语(want/decide/hope/plan/refuse/manage to do;疑问词+to do)
points.overview: want/decide/hope/plan/refuse/manage/wish/agree/offer/learn 等动词后接 to do 作宾语;know/wonder/decide/learn 等后接「疑问词(how/what/where/whether)+ to do」作宾语。

points.point: 不定式作宾语补足语(ask/tell/allow/encourage sb to do;使役 make/let/have sb do 不带 to)
points.overview: ask/tell/want/allow/encourage/advise/expect/invite sb to do,补足语带 to;但使役动词 make/let/have 及感官动词 hear/watch/feel/see 后接 sb + do(不带 to)。

points.point: 不定式作状语和定语(目的/结果状语 to do、so as to;the first/best to do、a way to do、sth to do)
points.overview: to do / in order to / so as to 作目的状语,…only to do 作结果状语;序数词/形容词最高级 + to do、a way/chance/time to do、sth/something to do 作定语,修饰前面的名词。

questions.stem: The young painter hopes ____ his works in a city gallery one day.
questions.explanation: hope 后接 to do 作宾语,表示希望去做某事。

questions.stem: Qi Baishi decided ____ on the finer details while his eyesight was still good.
questions.explanation: decide 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: The art student wants ____ how the masters mixed their colours.
questions.explanation: want 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: After many failures, Van Gogh refused ____ painting.
questions.explanation: refuse 后接 to do 作宾语,表示拒绝做某事。

questions.stem: Bob Dylan planned ____ a record so that his songs could be heard on the radio.
questions.explanation: plan 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: Although money was short, the artist managed ____ his exhibition on time.
questions.explanation: manage 后接 to do 作宾语,表示设法做成某事。

questions.stem: Before the show, the curator wondered how ____ the paintings on the walls.
questions.explanation: wonder 后接「疑问词 how + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: Many visitors do not know what ____ when they look at modern art.
questions.explanation: know 后接「疑问词 what + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: Have you ever wondered how ____ for a symphony performance?
questions.explanation: wonder 后接「疑问词 how + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: The beginner needs to decide where ____ to study calligraphy.
questions.explanation: decide 后接「疑问词 where + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: The two artists agreed ____ on a painting for the festival together.
questions.explanation: agree 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: Our music teacher offered ____ us to the opera this weekend.
questions.explanation: offer 后接 to do 作宾语,表示主动提出做某事。

questions.stem: The old master wished ____ his hometown through his ink paintings.
questions.explanation: wish 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: When his eyesight was failing, Qi still chose ____ on with his art.
questions.explanation: choose 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: The young singer is still learning how ____ a large audience.
questions.explanation: learn 后接「疑问词 how + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: Before the concert, Dylan could not decide which song ____ first.
questions.explanation: decide 后接「疑问词 which (song) + to do」作宾语。

questions.stem: After the festival, the students promised ____ another art club next term.
questions.explanation: promise 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: The painter expects ____ his new landscape before winter comes.
questions.explanation: expect 后接 to do 作宾语,此处无 sb,直接接 to do。

questions.stem: Some guests at the gallery were not sure whether ____ the artist for a photo.
questions.explanation: 「疑问词 whether + to do」作宾语,用于动词后(here: be sure 后)。

questions.stem: The committee hopes ____ the young artist with a special prize this year.
questions.explanation: hope 后接 to do 作宾语。

questions.stem: Our teacher advised us ____ the opera at least once this year.
questions.explanation: advise sb to do,不定式带 to 作宾语补足语。

questions.stem: At the theatre, the audience are required ____ quiet during the play.
questions.explanation: require sb to do(被动:be required to do),补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Sam asked the two noisy men behind him ____ chatting.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: The gallery does not allow visitors ____ the oil paintings.
questions.explanation: allow sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: His art teacher always encouraged him ____ his own style.
questions.explanation: encourage sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Yesterday I heard the street singer ____ "Blowin' in the Wind".
questions.explanation: 感官动词 hear sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The bright colours of the painting made the whole room ____ warmer.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make sth do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: Please let the children ____ the clay with their own hands.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 let sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The museum guide had us ____ in front of the most famous portrait.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 have sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: We watched the old painter ____ a few simple lines into a lively fish.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 watch sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The director told the actors ____ their lines more slowly on stage.
questions.explanation: tell sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Sam expected other people ____ the noisy men to be quiet.
questions.explanation: expect sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: The art club invited a local painter ____ a short talk about colour.
questions.explanation: invite sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Strong feelings in the music can make a quiet listener ____ aloud.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The judges wanted every group ____ five clues about a famous artist.
questions.explanation: want sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Soft background music can make the guests ____ more relaxed at the show.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 make sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The teacher let each student ____ one painting to introduce to the class.
questions.explanation: 使役动词 let sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: The school festival expects the winners ____ their work in the main hall.
questions.explanation: expect sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: We saw the dancer slowly ____ across the empty stage.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 see sb do,补足语不带 to。

questions.stem: Her parents always encouraged her ____ her dream of becoming a painter.
questions.explanation: encourage sb to do,补足语带 to。

questions.stem: Painters use a variety of brushes ____ different effects on the paper.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了创造……」。

questions.stem: Qi left some spaces blank ____ to add flowers later.
questions.explanation: so as to do 作目的状语,表示「以便……」。

questions.stem: Bob Dylan became the first songwriter ____ the Nobel Prize for Literature.
questions.explanation: 序数词 first 后用 to do 作定语,修饰 songwriter。

questions.stem: Every great artist needs a message ____ through colour and shape.
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 message,表示「要传达的信息」。

questions.stem: The students need a quiet place ____ their sketches in peace.
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 place,表示「用来完成……的地方」。

questions.stem: He worked hard all his life ____ his dream of world peace.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了追求……」。

questions.stem: Do you have the skills ____ a painting on your own?
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 skills,表示「欣赏……的技能」。

questions.stem: She arrived early at the gallery ____ a good seat near the stage.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了得到……」。

questions.stem: Van Gogh was probably the best painter ____ the beauty of a starry night.
questions.explanation: 形容词最高级 best 后用 to do 作定语,修饰 painter。

questions.stem: Spend some time figuring out the clues ____ the painter's true feelings.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了理解……」。

questions.stem: Is there anything ____ before the art exhibition opens tomorrow?
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰不定代词 anything。

questions.stem: He saved money for years, only ____ that the painting had already been sold.
questions.explanation: only to do 作结果状语,表示出乎意料的结果。

questions.stem: One good way ____ a painting is to place it in its time and place.
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 way,表示「欣赏……的方法」。

questions.stem: The young artist travelled to Paris in order ____ the works of the masters.
questions.explanation: in order to do 作目的状语,表示「为了研究……」。

questions.stem: Qi Baishi was one of the first Chinese artists ____ insects in such fine detail.
questions.explanation: 序数词 first 后用 to do 作定语,修饰 artists。

questions.stem: Visitors lined up ____ the most famous painting in the museum.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了看……」。

questions.stem: Now is the right time ____ your own art club at school.
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 time,表示「该……的时候」。

questions.stem: The museum stays open late ____ more working people a chance to visit.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了给……」。

questions.stem: He climbed onto the stage ____ the prize in person.
questions.explanation: to do 作目的状语,表示「为了亲自领奖」。

questions.stem: I'm looking for a fresh subject ____ in my next ink painting.
questions.explanation: to do 作定语,修饰 subject,表示「要画的题材」。
